product_metadata.title: PureFit Wrap Around Ruffled Bed Skirt with Adjustable Elastic Belt - 18 Inch Drop Easy to Put On, Wrinkle Free Bedskirt Dust Ruffles, Bed Frame Cover for Queen, King and C-King Size Bed, Baby Pink
features: A PERFECT FIT: The PureFit dust Ruffle bed shirt is designed to be a perfect fit for your Queen and King sizes beds thanks to the built-in adjustable elastic strap. The bed skirt measures 60"x80"x18". This multi-layer ruffle bed skirt is available in 23 beautiful and fade resistant colors

LUXURIOUS SILKY SATIN LIKE MICROFIBER FABRIC: This King and Queen size ruffled bed skirt is made from 100 percent silky satin-like microfiber fabric softly shirred for a romantic yet tailored look. The fabric is dust and stain resistant, wrinkle free and extremely soft and smooth

SUPER EASY TO PUT ON, DESIGNED TO FIT: Featuring a platform-free easy wrap around stretch & elastic adjustable construction, you can easily put this bed skirt on and off by yourself without lifting the mattress. This PureFit bed skirt fits Queen and King size mattresses

A GENEROUS 18-INCH DROP LENGTH: The dust ruffle/bed skirt has a generous drop of 18-inches length, reaches the floor easily and hides any under the bed storage, hides misshapen box springs, bed frames and bedposts, deflects dust and particles that might otherwise collect underneath your bed or simply to give your bed a uniform and sleek look
EASY CARE : Machine washable bed skirt, wash with like colors, gentle cycle, use only non-chlorine bleach, if needed, tumble dry low, Warm iron as needed.
